tagline: Quality outdoor equipment for Ashburton homes and farms
heroSubheading: Everything you need to keep your section and farm running
aboutHtml:
We are Jeff and Kerry Marshall, and we have been running STIHL SHOP Ashburton since 2015. Having lived in Ashburton our entire lives, we know what people here need to keep their homes and properties running. We supply STIHL petrol and battery equipment in-store and online.

You can buy online with home delivery or Click & Collect, and our friendly team is always ready to help you find the right equipment for your job. We stock a wide range of brands: STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda Power Equipment, Silky and Suzuki Motorcycles. We are proud to support local events and sports teams, and Jeff is the Deputy Chief Fire Officer for Ashburton.

Come in and see us. We are here Monday to Friday 8am to 5:30pm and Saturday to Sunday 9am to 3pm.
